claim: The name servers of a private hosted zone are reserved and never used by Route 53 public hosted zones. The private hosted zone information is not returned if you directly query the name servers over the internet; instead, VPC Resolver detects queries within a private namespace from the VPC to hosted zone associations and uses direct, private connectivity to reach the private DNS servers.

evidence.quote: These name servers are reserved and never used by Route 53 public hosted zones.
Further, the private hosted zone information is not returned if you directly query the name servers over the internet.
Instead, the VPC Resolver detects that queries are within a private namespace based on VPC to hosted zone associations and uses direct, private connectivity to reach the private DNS servers.
